b1-23.title: First day at the office
b1-23.story: Anna started a [[part-time]] job at a small travel company in Kyiv. On her first day, the manager's [[assistant]], Ira, showed her around the office. First, Anna signed an important [[document]] for her contract. Then Ira showed her how to send a [[fax]] on a very old machine. At ten, the team met to talk about a project [[deadline]] on Friday. Anna turned on the [[projector]], but the first [[slide]] was upside down! Everyone smiled, and the boss drew the plan on the [[whiteboard]] instead. "Good customer [[service]] is the most important thing here," he said. In the evening, Anna told Max, "I made a mistake, but I love this job!"

b1-24.title: The team meeting
b1-24.story: On Monday, the [[management]] of Anna's company called a team meeting. The boss wanted new ideas for summer trips, so they started with [[brainstorming]]. At first, the [[process]] was slow, and nobody wanted to speak. Then Anna shared an [[insight]] from her friends: teenagers love cheap weekend trips. "That's an [[aspect]] we always forget," said the boss. But two older workers started a small [[conflict]] about the budget. Anna listened and understood their [[motive]]: they both wanted happy customers. After that, the team made real [[progress]] in just one hour. The boss said Anna's idea had a lot of [[potential]]. Anna went home full of [[enthusiasm]] and told Max everything.

b1-25.title: Sofia's new start-up
b1-25.story: Max's sister Sofia wants to start a small business that repairs old phones. Last month, she went to a free [[workshop]] for young business people. There she explained her [[concept]]: fix phones instead of throwing them away. "Every phone has metal inside, and metal is a valuable [[resource]]," she said. The teacher called her a real [[innovator]]. A local bank liked the idea and wanted to be her first [[sponsor]]. They made her an [[offer]]: money for one year of rent. That evening, Anna helped her draw a [[logo]], a green phone with a heart. Max thought of the [[slogan]]: "Don't throw it, fix it!" The next day, Sofia put both on her new shop sign.

b1-26.title: Mama's big order
b1-26.story: Anna's mama works in [[retail]] and has a small clothes shop in Kyiv. Online shopping is having a [[boom]], so her shop is very busy. She decided to buy a new sewing machine from a [[dealer]] in Italy. It cost two thousand [[euros|euro]], so Dad, who works in [[banking]], helped with the payment. Luckily, the family kept some money in [[reserve]] for important things. The machine traveled by ship to the [[port]] of Odesa. Every evening, Mama checked the [[status]] of her order online. Finally, on Friday, a big box arrived at the shop. Taras was happier with the box than with the machine!

b1-27.title: Max joins a gym
b1-27.story: Max wanted to get stronger, so he joined a [[sport club]] near his home. Before that, he only went [[jogging]] in the park on weekends. On his first visit, a friendly [[fitness instructor]] showed him all the machines. "I'm almost six [[feet|foot]] tall, but I'm very thin," Max said. He looked at two huge men who were doing [[bodybuilding]] in the corner. "Don't worry, [[fitness]] is about health, not big muscles," she laughed. The next week, Sofia joined too because she wanted a personal [[fitness trainer]]. Her old dance [[instructor]] had moved to Lviv, and she missed exercise. Now they go to the club together every Tuesday and Thursday. Max still isn't big, but he can finally run five kilometers!

b1-28.title: At the doctor
b1-28.story: During exam week, Anna had bad headaches, so she took an [[aspirin]]. It didn't help, so she went to the doctor. She described her [[symptoms|symptom]]: headaches, tiredness, and [[discomfort]] in her eyes when reading. First, the doctor did a quick test for [[COVID]], and it was negative. "It's not a [[virus]]," she said. "I think it's [[stress]] and too much screen time." She sent Anna to an eye [[specialist]] the next day. He said Anna had dry eye [[syndrome]], which is common among students. In the hall, a poster gave a free helpline number for [[suicide]] prevention. Now Anna takes breaks from her phone, and her headaches are gone.

b1-29.title: The big match
b1-29.story: On Saturday, Anna's class played the [[handball]] final against another school. Anna was the [[goalkeeper]], and she was very nervous. In the first half, the [[referee]] gave the other team a penalty. Anna jumped and stopped the ball, and the whole class screamed. Then her [[teammate]] Ira scored two goals in five minutes. They won twelve to ten and became the school [[champions|champion]]! Each player got a small gold medal as a [[prize]]. After the match, Lisa had a [[karate]] competition in the same gym. She is small, but she is a real [[fighter]], and she won too. That evening, the friends celebrated their [[triumph]] with pizza.

b1-30.title: Fun by the ocean
b1-30.story: In August, Anna's family went on vacation to a small town by the [[ocean]]. There was always a light [[breeze]], so on the first day Dad and Anna tried [[windsurfing]]. They fell into the water many times, but they laughed a lot. On Tuesday, Anna went [[diving]] with a friendly local [[diver]]. He showed her a beautiful coral [[reef]] full of colorful fish. Mama preferred to stay on the beach under a high [[cliff]] and read. On the last day, the whole family went [[rafting]] on a river near the town. Taras was scared at first, but in the end he wanted to go again. "Next summer, we're coming back," Dad promised.
